notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.2-EarlyAccess!
notes.content:
[h3]0.8.2-EarlyAccess! Build Change Notes - February 1st, 2025
[/h3]

[h2][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h2]
The following cards have been updated:
[u][b]HANSEL[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 2 Mana 2/3
[*] New -> 2 Mana 2/[b]2[/b]
[i]Hansel and Gretel pack a huge punch in the early game, the 1 less Attack Power point in Hansel should make him feel more fair and less like a blind play.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/f20c838333682781708af89b6a2a145358dffdf0.png[/img]
[u][b]BEGGAR WOMAN[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 1 Mana 1/1
[*] New -> 1 Mana 1/[b]0[/b] 
[i]Beggar Woman is the clutch card. 1 Cost, card draw, what else could you ask for? She's the most played card from the starter deck outside of the Giant. Bringing her to 0 Attack Power gives her the cycle you still want but takes up a body on the field. Maybe there's a way to bring that 1 power back to her?[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/29d0fde6a307e428fa2a175e7a915a5b34121ac1.png[/img]
[u][b]TALKING CAT[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 4 Mana 2/3
[*] New -> 4 Mana 2/[b]5[/b] 
[i]Talking Cat is a wonderful card and we really love its ability, however, its poor statline makes it one of the first cards cut from the starter deck, this change might help those numbers.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/17d5685c5fce7e378eef02be1fcf4028778f704e.png[/img]
[u][b]MIRRORED FATE[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 3 Mana - Discard both players hands. They each draw 4 cards.
[*] New -> [b]5 Mana - Discard both players hands. They each draw 3 cards.[/b] 
[i]Mirrored Fate is a fun card. Dropping your entire hand into Bluebeard to send your entire hand out is a great feeling... if you're the one playing it. We've heard your concerns. Mirrored Fate is now a similar power level to Invoke Destruction but discarding the opponent's hand before Turn 6 is huge too.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/1bc005bab7f66e21b48674ced123b60ba5aff40a.png[/img]
[u][b]KNOIST[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 2 Mana 1/1 - Channel: Your Characters with no effects or abilities gain +4 Attack Power.
[*] New -> 2 Mana 1/1 - Channel: Your Characters with no effects or abilities gain [b]+3[/b] Attack Power.
[i]The Knoist drop is a huge bonus value in an infestation/tombstone deck. The slight nerf should make the curve feel much more manageable against decks like this.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/fd52b735008d2e11e50f5d975e4d064fa38880c5.png[/img]
[u][b]LITTLE MATCH GIRL[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 2 Mana 1/2 - On Play: If this is played at the left Realm, discard 2 Cards and draw 3 Cards.
[*] New -> [b]3[/b] Mana 1/2 - On Play: If this is played at the left Realm, discard 2 Cards and draw 3 Cards.
[i]Reducing Little Match Girl's discard potency did not stop the fear of the discard. Moving her to 3 mana might where you cant play her with Bluebeard on Turn 6. We'll continue to monitor her but we feel that Discard may need one more big card that lets people play it a different way, too.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/2d5f795f30c253ddb37e9136a0c61ec646306f73.png[/img]
[u][b]MASTER SCHULZ[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 6 Mana 5/4 - On Play: Your cards with Channel gain +2 Attack Power. +1 Attack Power for each Swabian card played this game.
[*] New -> [b]+3[/b] Attack Power for each Swabian card played this game.
[i]Swabian decks are just plain fun to play. The reward and dopamine you feel when you play 3+ Swabians need to feel as fun as the decks are. We're making it easier for Schulz to reach 10+ power due to how hard it is to play this deck.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/182abd995bb09a36738f5fbabeb768e2e85ba0ef.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.8.1-EarlyAccess!
notes.content:
[h3]0.8.1-EarlyAccess! Build Change Notes - January 6th, 2025
[/h3]

[h2][b]NEWS[/b][/h2]
The first Sky Cup Competition has come to a close! Congratulations to the winners!

[h2][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h2]
The following cards have been updated:
[u][b]RAPUNZEL[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 5 Mana 1/1 - Move a Character from your opponent's side here to your side.
[*] New -> [b]4[/b] Mana 1/1 - Move a Character from your opponent's side here to your side [b]and give it +1 Attack Power.[/b]
[i]Surprisingly to us, Rapunzel has been one of the lowest playrates in Grimm. We do think there needed to be an advantage based on her ability and adding 1 Attack Power as well as reducing her mana cost seems promising from internal playtesting. We're going to keep an eye on her for the future.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/819feca2a3ae87bae11737688830f94400b3c5e3.png[/img]
[u][b]MARLI SWABIAN[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 4 Mana 2/5 - At the end of each turn, give +1 Attack Power to your other Characters here.
[*] New -> [b]3 Mana 2/4[/b] 
[i]Marli Swabian is inherently a very good card just from the sheer amount of stats she gives. Reducing her mana cost gives her the ability to have one more end of turn proc and fits her into a solid 3-drop spot.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/c08ae24b38ec3a6966c23e614180fa1d277ac162.png[/img]
[u][b]AFFLICTED PRIEST[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 2 Mana 1/1 - Channel: Your other Characters here get +1 Health.
[*] New -> 2 Mana 1/[b]1[/b] 
[i]Afflicted Priest is a card most players unlock in their first 20 CCL levels. We needed to make him feel worth it in the 2-drop slot and buffing his attack makes him seem more worth it. We're going to evaluate him in the future as well.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/d3ba0c8680bd62c3c502134534e2c4b46356ec33.png[/img]
[u][b]GRETEL[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 4 Mana 1/4 - On Play: If you played Hansel this game, both this and Hansel gain +3 Attack Power.
[*] New -> 4 Mana 1/[b]2[/b] - On Play: If you played Hansel this game, both this and Hansel gain +3 Attack Power.
[i]Hansel and Gretel have always been an overly strong duo. Removing some of Gretel's initial Attack Power should balance them a bit more, giving Gretel 8 total points of power down from 10.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/2f928d8b0a8b750b79c2df2445312d31c2970dde.png[/img]
[u][b]WIDOW FISHER[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 3 Mana 1/4 - On Play: Add the bottom Card of your deck here.
[*] New -> 3 Mana 1/[b]1[/b] - On Play: Add the bottom [b]Character[/b] of your deck here.
[i]There has been some super crazy combos with Widow Fisher and he's just overall a totally solid card. Bluebeard decks have really been hoping for the Invoke Destruction pull when Widow Fisher is played to discard your entire hand and throw it on the board. Changing his ability to just be a Character will slightly nerf most discard decks but will end up being beneficial when you hook a 6-drop.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/f0a59f69f287ebd7e0603481dbbc3b3dec1211ea.png[/img]
[u][b]LITTLE MATCH GIRL[/b][/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 2 Mana 1/2 - On Play: If this is played at the left Realm, discard your hand and draw 3 Cards.
[*] New -> 2 Mana 1/2 - On Play: If this is played at the left Realm, [b]discard 2 Cards[/b] and draw 3 Cards.
[i]Little Match Girl has been the #1 most played card in Bluebeard and Bearskin discard decks. Reducing the amount of cards she can discard should make her feel better in the 2-drop slot. We did not want to increase her mana cost as that would have probably had her not seen any play. We hope that this change makes it more fair when you're against a discard deck.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/419a736619be0d31e2e10e8e6417a0f1f9a75cfb.png[/img]
[b][h3][u]NEW ART[/u][/h3][/b]
[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44244256/07f158004be36e6e8422f71d9095c01f25eca7c9.png[/img]

[h3]0.7.21-EarlyAccess-003! Build Change Notes - October 9, 2024
[/h3]

[b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b]
[u][b]THE JUDGE[/b][/u] 
[list]

[h3]0.7.17-EarlyAccess! Build Change Notes - September 3, 2024
[/h3]

[b]**NEW**[/b]
All players now have [b]Rank Points![/b] Rank Points (RP) are a way for you and other players to see how good you are at the game. Every player starts at 1200 Rank Points. Players will always try to be matched against someone near their own RP so that the game feels fair. 

When you win or lose a match, you'll receive or lose RP according to whether the match "expected" you to win or lose (based on your Rank Points) and the actual outcome.

Examples:
- Player 1 has 1400 RP and loses vs Player 2 who has 1500 RP. Player 1 only loses 15 RP and Player 2 gains 14 RP.
- Player 1 has 1400 RP and wins vs Player 2 who has 1500 RP. Player 1 gains 33 RP and Player 2 loses 27 RP.
- Player 1 has 1800 RP and wins vs Player 2 who has 1300 RP. Player 1 gains 8 RP and Player 2 loses 7 RP.
- Player 1 has 1800 RP and loses vs Player 2 who has 1300 RP. Player 1 loses 78 RP and Player 2 gains 96 RP.

[b]Rank Points Tiers[/b]:
[list]
[*] Above 2100 - Ultimate
[*] 1850-2100 - Master
[*] 1500-1850 - Apprentice
[*] 1200-1500 - Trainee
[*] Under 1200 - Novice
[/list]
The RP system is to promote a healthy competitive edge to World of Grimm. You'll never be able to buy anything that boosts or modifies your RP and your RP will reset slightly each season.

notes.content:
[h3]0.6.5-EarlyAccess! Build Change Notes - April 10, 2024
[/h3]

[b]NEW CARD[/b]:
[list]
[*] Widow Fisher - 3 Mana 1/4 - On Play: Add the bottom Card of your deck here.
[/list]

[b]NEW CARD ART[/b]:
[list]

[/list]

[b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b]
[u]Goose Girl[/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> Channel: +1 Attack Power for each Card in your deck.
[*] New -> Channel: [b]+2 [/b]Attack Power for each Card in your deck.
[i]We've noticed that Goose Girl really lacks anything exciting by the end of Turn 6 in her present state. By increasing how much she gets for your deck size, she seems more dynamic for a 5 Mana card. We're going to continue to monitor her in the future but we think this is a great change for Tombstone decks.[/i]
[/list]
[u]Gravekeeper[/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> On Play: Add a Tombstone to your side here. Your Tombstones get +2 Attack Power.
[*] New -> On Play: Add a Tombstone to your side here. [b]Channel: [/b]Your Tombstones get +2 Attack Power.
[i]Gravekeeper is a card that has such a large part of Tombstone decks and you unlock him relatively early in your collection. This change adding a channel to his ability should give your Tombstone decks even more excitement.[/i]
[/list]
[u]Swan Maiden[/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> On Play: +3 Health and +3 Attack Power.
[*] New -> [b]On Play: +2 Health and +2 Attack Power.[/b]
[i]Swan Maiden's power boost is too strong so we reduced it slightly, especially when Cloud Kingdom appears or Hildebrand is played.[/i]
[/list]
[u]Hansel[/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 2 Mana 4/3
[*] New -> 2 Mana [b]2/3[/b]
[i]Let's face it, Hansel has a huge health stat. He's a kid, kid's aren't THAT big, even if they eat so much that they get stuck in a cage and the Child-Eater plans on cooking them. This change adds a vulnerability to Hansel that lets some damaging cards try to kill him and actually feel like they're getting through his thick skin.[/i]
[/list]
[u]Snake Prince[/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> 3 Mana 2/2
[*] New -> 3 Mana [b]2/3[/b]
[i]Snake Prince is an interesting card, if he gets played without any buffs, he was only adding 8 power to a Realm and locking it for any new cards. This buff should make a Realm you play him at a more strategic play.[/i]
[/list]
[u]Huntsman[/u] 
[list]
[*] Mechanics update - Ability now destroys and [b]kills ANY card[/b] the opponent plays at that Realm, not just the first Card played.
[i]Huntsman has such a fun ability. Correctly sniping the enemy's play and removing the card that might win them the game is such a great feeling. We needed to make it consistent with player expectations so this quality of life buff should really feel like he's in the right place.[/i]
[/list]
[u]Golden Princess[/u] 
[list]
[*] Old -> Channel: Whenever a Card is destroyed or it's Health reaches 0, draw a card.
[*] New -> Channel: Whenever a Card is destroyed or [b]dies[/b], draw a card.
[i]We're in the process of cleaning up some Card text to create normalcy and consistency among card texts. This is the start of that as a card dying is specifically when Health reaches 0.[/i]
[/list]

[*] White Shroud
Old - 2 Mana 0/6 | On Play: One of your Characters gets +2 Attack Power and -2 Health.
[b]New [/b]- 2 Mana 2/1 | On Play: The next Character you play swaps its Attack Power and Health.
[i]White Shroud ended up being a Card that you played that usually killed one of your other cards on the board. 2 Damage is pretty severe for most cards, especially in the beginning turns. This change to White Shroud should really fit him into a nice support role.[/i]

[*] Invoke Destruction
Old - 5 Mana Spell | On Play: Discard your hand, add a 6-Mana Card here.

[b]New [/b]-> 4 Mana [b]5/2[/b] - On Play: If your opponent has more than 4 Cards in their hand, double this Attack Power.

[*] Maid Maleen

New - 2 Mana Spell | Swap the lowest mana Card in your hand with a Card in your opponent's hand. Give the swapped Card +1 Attack Power.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.4.2
notes.content:
[h3]0.4.2 Build Change Notes - October 27, 2023
[/h3]

[b]CARD UPDATES[/b]
[u]GRETEL[/u]
Old (4 Mana 2/4) On Play: If you played Hansel this game, double Hansel and this card's Attack Power.
-> New (4 Mana [b]1[/b]/4) [b]On Play: If you played Hansel this game, both this and Hansel gain +3 Attack Power.[/b]
[i]Hansel and Gretel are such an immense powerhouse and snowball out of control too easily. Reducing Gretel's ability still makes them collectively a solid amount of Attack Power but you won't see Hansel reaching 80 Attack consistently anymore.[/i]

[u]WITCH MOTHER[/u]
Old (1 Mana 1/1) -> New (1 Mana 1/[b]0[/b])
[i]If Witch Mother is played on turn 1 and every turn after, she ends up being 16 Attack on the final turn. Even though you have spent 6 mana over 6 turns to get her to this point, she can be buffed by too many other cards and realms. Reducing her Attack to 0 requires you to combo her into a sequence to try to get her to snowball.[/i]

[u]SNOW WHITE[/u]
Old (5 Mana 5/4) -> New (5 Mana, [b]1[/b]/4)
[i]Princesses should be more frail to align with their storylines. Snow White's ability is so strong that bringing her Health to 1 should be more than efficient to make her feel like an easier target to remove and kill.[/i]

[u]SWAN MAIDEN[/u]
Old (5 Mana 5/4) -> New (5 Mana [b]2[/b]/4)
[i]Swan Maiden fits in the same archetype and reasoning as Snow White. Her ability is so strong that it makes her Health untouchable.[/i]

[/h3]

[b]CARD CHANGES[/b]:
[u]CINDERELLA[/u]
Old (4 Mana 5/6) -> New (4 Mana [b]2[/b]/6)
[i]We reduced the Health side of Cinderella to open her up to counterplay. She was super overstated so we're adjusting both her and [u]The Stepmother[/u] to make it more fair.

[/i][u]THE STEPMOTHER[/u]
Old (4 Mana 6/5) -> New (4 Mana [b]3[/b]/5)

[u]THE WOLF[/u]
Old (6 Mana 5/4, At end of game, +3 Attack Power for each card in opponent's hand) 
New (6 Mana [b]2/5[/b], At end of game,[b] +2 Attack Power for each card in opponent's hand[/b]) 
[i]The Wolf impacts the game at the very end of the game, we've noticed through significant playtests that he's typically getting +12-15 Attack Power. Reducing his bonus but giving him one more Attack Power should balance him out and feel more fair. There really is no counterplay for cards that have end of match text, so we're really optimistic on this change.[/i]
